scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix mobile && npm install --prefix holobox
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,mobile,holobox -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix mobile" "npm run dev --prefix holobox"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix mobile && npm run build --prefix holobox
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --prefix backend
